                                                                                
 Usage: agentarts launch [OPTIONS]                                              
                                                                                
 Deploy agent to Huawei Cloud or run locally. (alias: deploy)                   
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent                  -a      <str>  Agent name (uses default if not      │
│                                         specified)                           │
│ --mode                   -m      <str>  Deploy mode: 'local' for local       │
│                                         Docker, 'cloud' for Huawei Cloud SWR │
│                                         (default)                            │
│                                         [default: cloud]                     │
│ --tag                    -t      <str>  Docker image tag [default: latest]   │
│ --local-port             -l      <int>  Local port mapping (for local mode)  │
│ --swr-org                        <str>  SWR organization (overrides config)  │
│ --swr-repo                       <str>  SWR repository (overrides config)    │
│ --description            -d      <str>  Agent description (overrides config) │
│ --skip-build                            Skip build/push, use config URL to   │
│                                         create agent directly                │
│ --skip-ssl-verification  -k             Skip SSL certificate verification    │
│ --help                                  Show this message and exit.          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
